findings.note: Instrument-only. The digest's MISSING hp on feats/monk-moves was wg-values flattening a conditional gated on ANOTHER feat (FEAT_NAMES INCLUDES 'monk resiliency') into an unconditional Hit Point op. AoN feat-6214 prints only the Speed clause; the Hit Points are AoN feat-6212's ('3 additional Hit Points for each monk archetype class feat you have') and we already hold them once, on feats/monk-resiliency.maxHpBonus {perArchetypeFeat:3, archetype:'monk'}. Fixed in the comparer (scripts/wg-values.mjs theirValueOps) rather than by 59 settles; three now-dead SETTLED_VALUES entries deleted with it. No content change is correct here - a row would ADD Hit Points the book does not grant.
